title: TAI PUBLIC non-TAI ACL production repair
objective: Remove only the exactly attested PUBLIC relation ACL entries that give the orphan tai_runtime principal effective access to two non-TAI public-schema relations, prove API/web and durable intake remain healthy, retain an exact inverse rollback, then allow the existing direct-grant repair and standalone TAI deployment to complete.
boundaries: The only production command is /tai repair-public-non-tai-acls current-main on issue 3365
Commenter, actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner
Exact current main must have successful TAI Controller Sync and TAI REG.RU Preflight authority
Transport uses only the canonical REG.RU host, protected root SSH principal and pinned host fingerprint
No repair runs while a TAI container, dedicated environment file or TAI Compose override exists
Exact-main API/web containers and the single persistent PostgreSQL authority are proven before mutation
tai_runtime must have the exact least-privilege attributes, no memberships, no grants to other roles, no sessions and no owned objects
Exactly two non-TAI public-schema relations must be effectively accessible and every effective privilege must be explained by a non-grantable PUBLIC relation ACL
Only SELECT or REFERENCES PUBLIC privileges may be removed; INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, TRIGGER, column grants and grant options fail closed
No ACL entry belonging to tai_runtime, an application role or any other named principal is changed by this repair
The original PUBLIC ACLs are serialized into an exact inverse rollback before mutation
PUBLIC ACL revocation is one PostgreSQL transaction and postcondition requires zero effective non-TAI relation privileges for tai_runtime
RU/EN/ZH public live acceptance plus durable PostgreSQL, audit and outbox verification must pass before finalization
Any acceptance failure executes the exact inverse rollback and verifies restoration
DROP OWNED, REASSIGN OWNED, DROP ROLE, object deletion, tenant mutation, application deployment and model mutation are forbidden
No authority is widened and no new recurring cost is introduced
